result.summary: The page is generally coherent, but the fixed bottom navigation visibly overlaps the next restaurant card, and horizontally scrolling content is clipped at the screen edges.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar covers the lower portion of the second popular restaurant card, leaving the card visibly cut off and potentially hiding its content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page or ensure the content can scroll above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant carousel is clipped at the right edge, with the third card and category chip only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: If horizontal scrolling is intended, add clearer carousel affordance and ensure clipped cards are fully accessible; otherwise constrain the content to the viewport.
